 Pune 
 weather 
 November 15, 2026 by Divyani Sharma 
The image is just for representational purposes 
 Shivajinagar logs a minimum 3.3 degrees below normal; NDA station dips to 10.2°C 
 Pune: Pune woke up to its coldest morning of the season on Sunday, with the minimum temperature at the India Meteorological Department’s (IMD) Shivajinagar observatory falling to 12.1°C. It is the lowest minimum recorded at the station this season and the lowest since January 12, 2026, according to weather data shared by research scientist Vineet Kumar. The reading was 3.3 degrees Celsius below the seasonal normal, which made the morning chill noticeably sharper than usual for mid-November. The city saw no rain in the 24 hours up to 8.30 am on Sunday. Relative humidity during the morning observation stood at 71%. Other parts of the district were colder still. The weather station at the National Defence Academy (NDA) recorded a minimum of 10.2°C. Temperatures across Pune district can differ quite a bit from one station to another, so the numbers vary depending on where they are taken. 
Make Pune Mirror My Trusted Source 
 The IMD expects mainly clear skies to continue over the city in the coming days. Night and early morning temperatures are likely to stay around 12 to 13°C until November 21, while daytime highs should hover between 30 and 32°C. The department has not issued any weather warning for Pune for this period. The result is a widening gap between mornings and afternoons. Residents can expect cool starts to the day, followed by warm, sunny afternoon.
